purpose: Immutable timestamped snapshots. Captures prior state before any rewrite (NAQD reconciliation, schema migration, registry update).
allowed_contents: YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ/* (snapshot folders, each with MANIFEST.json listing SHA256 of mirrored files)
policy: Append-only. No deletion. No editing of past snapshots.
manifest_schema: Each snapshot folder contains MANIFEST.json with { ts, trigger, files: [{path, sha256, size}], note }
